chip.description: Hardware multiplier coprocessor mapped into the 68000 address space.
chip.notes: Identified as "hardware multiplier" in the custom-parts table of src/mame/sega/segaic16.cpp (MAME 0.288), fitted to System 16B, Out Run (x2) and X-Board (x3); Guru notes in src/mame/sega/segas16b.cpp give "315-5248 - Custom Sega IC (QFP100)". Filed dsp on taxonomy §4.3's "a documented math engine is dsp even when it is a board-specific part"; flagged as a judgement call, since Q2 is written around microcoded engines and this is fixed silicon.
